column7: BulkDeleteSecrets decided each item at the secret's own {project, environment} only, so a user or machine holding secrets.delete in one environment (not at the project) could delete that environment's secrets through a direct core call while REST refused them at the secrets.delete@project route gate (proven by the authzdiff A@prod variations). Core now calls requireScopedGate(secrets.delete, project) before any secret is read; a refusal deletes and audits nothing. Actor 0 (local/embedded pseudo-actor) unchanged. Defence in depth: REST already refused and there is no gRPC method.
